summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing its participation in a fireside chat at the H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual BioConnect Investor Conference on May 19, 2026. No material corporate transaction, strategic review, or extraordinary event is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report for a standard investor conference participation. As a Canadian filer, this 6-K corresponds to a voluntary U.S. disclosure of ordinary business activities. No deal terms, board recommendations, or special-situation mechanics are present. No actionable risk-arb angle exists; the filing is purely informational.
